## Nuke the desktop/AGM residue: the electron editor separated into its own repo… — 2026-07-27 (parent 619f291899f7)

The entire AGM (desktop/Attention Graph Model) subsystem has been excised from the codebase. Deleted modules include `trie/attention`, `trie/attention_store`, `trie/sync/attention_fold`, and `trie/graph/system_model`, along with their test files `tests/test_attention` and `tests/test_system_model`.

Surviving code is cleaned up accordingly:
- `trie/graph/store`: `SCHEMA_VERSION` bumped to v10, `hist_mass`/`hist_mass_ts` columns dropped from `SCHEMA_SQL`, `Store.historical_mass_all` and the AGM surface removed, `Store.upsert_section_record` no longer accepts mass parameters
- `trie/sync/writer`: `Section`, `TriefactFile.render`, `TriefactFile.upsert_section` strip all `hist_mass` handling; `format_hist_mass`, `parse_hist_mass`, `TriefactFile.set_section_historical_mass` deleted; `SECTION_OPEN_RE` retains a bare tolerance pattern for old sentinels
- `trie/mcp_server`: `TrieTools.attention`, `record_attention_event`, `set_investigation`, `all_edges`, `all_symbols`, `system_model` removed; remaining tool docstrings drop desktop-app framing
- `trie/cli`: attention-watermark advance removed from `_activity_progress`; `_connect` in `trie/activity` reworded from "the editor" to "other pollers"
